Subject: Post-signature: Gatekeeper MAP and deployment cadence

Hi Elena —

Congrats again on getting the SOW across the finish line. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (Gatekeeper_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation checkpoints: rollout windows, canary schedule, migration gating, and training timeline. Key asks from our side in this draft:

- Confirm target go-live month (we've penciled Q1 2027 with a final cutover week of 2027-03-14).
- Agree the canary cohort (we propose 2% of production traffic across 3 tenants for an initial 48-hour validation).
- Provide the list of internal stakeholders for training (names and preferred week slots).
- Confirm acceptance metrics for the evaluation plan (latency P90, error-rate ceiling, and quality checks on a 500-sample prompt deck).

I also included an initial Eval Plan tab — Markus will follow up with explicit validation criteria and rollback thresholds. Please review and let us know where you want us to tighten the cadence. If you're good with this structure we'll lock the version and create a DocuSign package for the final SOW trackers.

Attachments: Gatekeeper_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova

Subject: Re: Post-signature: Gatekeeper MAP and deployment cadence

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the clear template. Quick notes:

- Go-live: BrightLine is targeting a commercial go-live window between 2027-03-14 and 2027-03-21. We prefer the earlier half of that window if canary validation completes.
- Canary: The 2% cohort and 48-hour window sounds reasonable. Can your team confirm how the KV cache priming will be handled for the canary tenants? We want to avoid cold-start noise in the first 4 hours.
- Training: I'll loop in our internal training lead (Amit Rao, copied) to propose attendee lists and preferred dates.
- Evaluation: we'll need the evaluation plan (metrics, sample prompts) for our compliance team to sign off.

On SSO and data residency: we require confirmation that audit logs for inference requests will be retained for 90 days in the US region. Please advise whether that is covered by the Dedicated deployment settings or if we need an add-on.

I'll review Gatekeeper_MAP_v1 this afternoon and come back with consolidated comments or redlines.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Director, Product Ops — BrightLine Health

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: Gatekeeper MAP and deployment cadence

Elena, Sofia —

Attaching a detailed evaluation plan (Gatekeeper_EvalPlan_20261101.docx) with measurable pass/fail criteria. High-level highlights here so we have alignment before locking dates:

- Canary plan: 3 tenants (2% traffic), 48-hour validation window, staged ramp at 0%, 0.5%, 1.5%, 2%.
- Monitoring: P90 latency target = 1100ms for inference calls, error-rate ceiling = 0.8% (5xx + manifested inference errors), degradation threshold triggers rollback if sustained > 0.5% over 30 minutes.
- Quality checks: 500-sample prompt deck (mixed modality) — automated A/B scoring against baseline model + manual review for 10% of failures.
- KV cache priming: We'll run a synthetic prefix warm-up for the canary tenants 2 hours before ramp to avoid noisy cold-starts; this will be included in the MAP tasks.
- Rollback: Immediate rollback to previously pinned model (v3.2) if degradation threshold exceeded; run root-cause and follow-up hotfix window.

I put tentative slots for training: week of 2027-02-21 and 2027-03-07 (remote, 90-minute sessions + office hours). Monica — can you confirm instructor assignments and seat counts?

Attachments: Gatekeeper_EvalPlan_20261101.docx

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@brightline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@insight-ops.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: Gatekeeper MAP and deployment cadence

Thanks Markus — that level of detail helps. A couple of follow-ups from BrightLine IT and compliance: 

- Audit logs: we need the request/response audit trail retained for 90 days in US only. Is that captured by the Dedicated deployment package, or will we need the logging add-on? Please confirm exact retention and whether logs include payload hashes only or full prompts.
- Training seats: Amit (copied) — can your team confirm 18 seats for the first session and 6 seats for the follow-up technical deep-dive? We will provide a list of users by 2026-11-08.
- Eval deck: we need the 500-sample prompt deck in CSV form for our internal reviewer; can that be exported from your EvalPlan docx or do you already have a CSV?

We reviewed the MAP and have one small timeline ask: move the first canary ramp (0.5%) to 2027-03-15 morning PT if possible — that aligns with our peak off-hours. 

I'll aim to get you the attendee list + compliance checklist by Monday.

Best,
Elena

Elena / team —

Thanks for the quick review and the specific asks. I've consolidated decisions and next actions into the MAP owner view in Drive (link below) and added a short checklist we can track weekly. Summary and next steps:

- Go-live window: Tentatively locked to 2027-03-14 -> 2027-03-21 subject to canary sign-off.
- Canary ramp: First 0.5% ramp set to 2027-03-15 02:00 PT per BrightLine request; 48-hour validation to follow.
- KV priming: Redwood to run synthetic warm-up 2 hours prior to first ramp; Markus has this as an action item.
- Audit logs: Confirmed — Dedicated deployment with logging add-on will persist full request/response hashes and metadata for 90 days; full prompts are stored only as hashed payloads unless explicit archival opt-in is signed (see SOW tracker). SOW_Tracker_Gatekeeper_v3.pdf attached for reference.
- Training: Instructors assigned — Monica (onboarding & business ops), Markus (tech deep-dive). First session: 2027-02-21 (18 seats). Tech deep-dive: 2027-03-07 (6 seats). Amit to confirm list by 2026-11-08.
- Eval deck: Markus will export the 500-sample CSV and drop it into the Drive folder by 2026-11-05.
